modifications: Design consultation only; no Godot code is copied or translated.

Adopted the TAA discontinuity response principle: on a presentation stall the trail history converges by a bounded 250 ms decay step instead of hard-cutting to a reseed, mirroring how taa_resolve raises the blend factor on disocclusion rather than keeping stale history or flickering.

Adopted a softened history-coverage boundary (two-texel smoothstep fade, only while the history transform is non-identity) as the trail analog of TAA off-screen history rejection; untransformed history keeps full coverage so plain trails are not dimmed at the frame border.

Rejected full motion-vector reprojection, 3x3 variance clipping and Catmull-Rom history sampling: the trail is a deliberate echo effect without per-pixel velocity in the 2D texture chain, and bilinear resampling blur is part of the authored aesthetic. The extra passes and a velocity buffer are not justified by any authored work.
